title: We're in Wonder as We Worship
lyrics_original: You're the Word standing for all time.
You are God and with God.
And from You come all things.
By the Word of Your power.
We're in wonder as we worship
You're our Savior and our God!
You are holy, You are mighty,
King of kings and Lord of lords.
By Your power You have saved us,
For God so loved the world
That He gave us His Son.
We're in wonder as we worship
You're our Savior and our God!
You are holy, You are mighty,
King of kings and Lord of lords.
By Your power You have saved us,
On You, holy Lamb of God,
Lay the guilt that we bore.
The full cup of God's wrath.
We're in wonder as we worship
You're our Savior and our God!
You are holy, You are mighty,
King of kings and Lord of lords.
By Your power You have saved us,
And were raised in great power.
On the right hand of God
Who can condemn us? You bought us
And You stand as our Advocate,
We're in wonder as we worship
You're our Savior and our God!
You are holy, You are mighty,
King of kings and Lord of lords.
By Your power You have saved us,

bible_verses.english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation. For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him and for him. He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

God, having in time past spoken to the fathers by the prophets at many times and in various ways, has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the ages. His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are the radiance of God’s glory and the Creator of all things, yet You chose to redeem us. I stand in awe of Your power that upholds the universe and Your grace that reached down to save my soul. Help me to carry this quiet wonder with me throughout my day. Teach my heart to worship You not just in song, but in full surrender to Your majesty. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Before the foundation of the world, Jesus stood as the eternal Word, holding all life and creation in His hands. Yet this same almighty God, who upholds the cosmos by His powerful word, stepped down to become our Savior. As we consider His divine glory and incredible humility, our hearts cannot help but bow in silent awe. May this song draw you into a place of quiet wonder, reminding you that the One who sustains the universe is the very One who saved you.
